text.tspan: As directed by Richard Miller we are in the process of creating an Engineering Archive system at
Atari Dallas. In keeping with this effort we will need information regarding the COMBEL,
VIDEL, and AJAX ICs. If possible all information should be sent in both hard copy and
electronic copy (on disk). We need all pertinent design information, including macro/mega cell
schematics, test vectors (that have not been created here, if any), fault vectors (again any that
have not been created here), layout information, and any manufacturing information. Especially
needed for the Specifications are timing diagrams and AC/DC Electrical Specifications. The goal
is to archive a set of information that will be complete in the event the part must be looked at
here in detail. In other words, all design information residing anywhere will be stored in one
central location for use by everyone. Your help and cooperation in this matter is greatly
